Nine countries are thought to have nuclear weapons, and six more host weapons that aren't theirs. Here is who is who.

a thread 🧵🗺️
1/ Five are recognised under the Non-Proliferation Treaty: the US, Russia, the UK, France and China. Data: Wikipedia (Oct 2026).
2/ Three more have declared arsenals outside the treaty: India, Pakistan and North Korea. Israel has never formally confirmed having any, so the map marks it as undeclared.

3/ Six countries host weapons that belong to someone else. Belgium, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands and Turkey host US weapons under NATO nuclear sharing. Belarus has hosted Russian weapons since 2023.
4/ Some gave theirs up. Kazakhstan transferred its Soviet-era weapons to Russia by 1995, Ukraine's were removed by 1996, and South Africa dismantled the six it had built in the early 1990s.
A very small club, with a wider ring of host countries around it. Which group on this map surprises you most? Follow @forummapping for more maps like this.
